_about: T-453 (C-186): DAEMONS' BPS patches, newest first, as published on GitHub (the assets of each release on CodeMusic/DAEMONS). Nothing of Nintendo's is here: the app fetches url, checks patch.sha1 (or sha256, which GitHub also reports), checks the player's own ROM against source (sha1, or crc32 as a BPS patcher does; md5 for tools that show only that), applies the patch, and checks the result against target.sha1. A patch fits only its own source revision; 1.0 and Rev 1 are both common. CONTENT is FireRed's edition, CONTEXT LeafGreen's. latest is the newest version.
